comparison.objective: Candidate finishes inserts by tang fracture; record loads liquid bottles into an autoclave inside a secondary tray clear of chamber walls.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires aligned impact tooling and fragment recovery; record requires stable bottle/tray loading, spacing, and spill-safe placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures and complete tang containment; record requires bottles in the secondary tray with wall clearance, but available evidence omits numeric clearance, spill, and stability thresholds.
comparison.reason: Autoclave loading and clearance management are clearly different from insert finishing; absent rubric numbers do not imply duplication.
